reason: The plugin is primarily an external LLM service integration for dsh: it is explicitly positioned as a Cline free-model provider, reads a configured API key/credential reference, and synchronizes model metadata from a Cline endpoint so models can be used in dsh’s Web Models workflow.

summaries.zh: 本插件用于将 dsh 与 Cline 的免费模型服务对接，读取已配置的 API Key 后从 Cline 端同步模型列表，并在 Web Models 中供模型调用使用。
summaries.en: This plugin integrates dsh with Cline free-model services by using a configured API key, syncing model catalog data from a Cline endpoint, and making those models available for use in dsh Web Models.

capabilities: reads LLM credential reference from DSH credentials or environment variable
performs network calls to a configured Cline base URL
registers a dynamic model provider for dsh runtime

reasons.code: README documents credential-backed configuration via `CLINE_API_KEY` and a configurable `baseURL` for `https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`, indicating external API access with user-supplied credentials.
Package description and peer dependency set reference Cline and DSH LLM runtime modules, indicating the plugin bridges dsh to an external model service and scans a remote model catalog.
